dct_title_s: Stokes and High Point, New Jersey 1962 maps
dct_description_sm: Maps of Stokes State Forest and High Point State Park in Sussex County, N.J. part of multi-page brochure. These sheets are two maps of area. First includes inset guide to Kittle Field and description of Tillman Ravine and the hiking trails. Second map High Point State Park with one photograph and descriptions of the western section of the monument, wildlife sanctuary, hiking and the Lodge and Inn. Legend indicates paved roads, unpaved trails, streams and other waterways, camp grounds and park office.
